results.check: Note headers and stated ages match the patient record
Every text PDF page prints the filed patient, MRN and encounter
DICOM headers (identity, dates, accession, SYN, burned-in) match catalog and patient
Imaging reports reference their study/accession and state no interpretation
Encounters are finished, non-overlapping and end before the as-of date
results.note: No encounter is in progress, so no patient is currently admitted.

results.check: Measurements fall within their encounter (pre-visit labs allowed for telehealth reviews)
results.note: 2 labs drawn up to 5 days before a telehealth review and linked to it (documented in the note)

results.check: Lab flags agree with reference ranges; every value has UCUM unit and LOINC code
Orders authored within their encounter; dose-change chains and statuses consistent with dates
Discharge-summary medication tables match orders active at discharge
Every lab value of the covered encounters appears on lab reports and discharge summaries
Follow-up statuses are consistent with the as-of date and resolving encounters
Portal threads open with a patient message after the related encounter and summaries match
Every value stated in a brief item appears in the records it references
results.note: Brief items are deterministic summaries; none contains diagnostic or treatment language.

results.check: Worklist ages (as of the record date) and last-encounter dates match source records
